title: kate-text: TextBuffer, Offset, CharRange, Edit, Transaction
summary: The storage layer and the one edit primitive. A ropey::Rope behind TextBuffer, flat char offsets, and Transaction as a sorted list of non-overlapping Replace edits applied atomically with validation. Insert and delete are not separate operations; they are Edits with an empty side. No anchors, no undo, no files: those are PKT-0003 to PKT-0005.

lane.reason: Pure library crate, platform independent, heavy on property tests. Exactly what a cloud VM is for; it does not need macOS and it should not occupy the owner's machine.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New crate API. Replaces nothing. Line endings are not this crate's problem: text arrives already normalized to \n (PKT-0005).

regression_tests.name: buffer::tests::apply_then_apply_inverse_is_identity
regression_tests.asserts: For any text and any valid Transaction, apply(tx) then apply(tx.invert()) yields the original text and revision advanced by exactly 2. Fixed proptest seed in CI.

regression_tests.name: buffer::tests::old_text_mismatch_is_rejected
regression_tests.asserts: An Edit whose `old` does not match the buffer returns ApplyError::OldTextMismatch and leaves text and revision untouched.

regression_tests.name: edit::tests::overlapping_edits_are_rejected_at_construction
regression_tests.asserts: Transaction::new with two edits whose ranges overlap returns TransactionError::Overlap; adjacent (touching) edits are accepted.

regression_tests.name: buffer::tests::line_col_round_trips_on_every_boundary
regression_tests.asserts: offset(line_col(o)) == o for every offset in a generated multi-line text including the final offset after the last char.
